performanceUserTiming.directlyObserved: At the requested exact revision the producer captures base::TimeTicks::Now() into callTime, adds that captured value to the trace details, and gives the User Timing event the mark's UnsafeTimeForTraces timestamp. These are separate fields with different production paths.
performanceUserTiming.supports: A mark event.ts must not be substituted for physical mark-call evidence; a supplied startTime can affect the mark timestamp while callTime remains captured when the producer executes.
performanceUserTiming.limitation: The exact TimeTicks-to-trace JSON serializer was not one of the two authorized files. Units and payload schema are additionally constrained by the actual R3 native record and prior official trace-type evidence. Do not claim a complete serialization proof or a normative web-standard callTime API.

frameRequestCallbackCollection.directlyObserved: The non-internal registration path increments its callback counter, stores id on the callback, returns that id, and passes id into RequestAnimationFrame trace data. FireAnimationFrame receives the stored callback id and its trace scope encloses callback Invoke. Cancelled callbacks are checked before that Fire scope.
frameRequestCallbackCollection.supports: Source-level causal linkage from registration id to native Fire producer argument, corroborated by R3 captured JavaScript handles and actual trace payload ids on the expected renderer/document.
frameRequestCallbackCollection.limitation: The requestAnimationFrame Web IDL binding and inspector_animation_frame_event::Data field serializer are not defined in these two files. The complete exposed-handle-to-payload chain is empirically corroborated by R3, not proved solely by these excerpts. No universal no-wrap/no-reuse guarantee is asserted.

sourceInterpretation.provenance: Connector returned decoded UTF-8 source rather than GitHub Contents JSON. No authoritative original Git blob sha or full-source byte hash was returned, so both are explicitly null. Only hashes of the actual retained normalized UTF-8 excerpt bytes may be added; they must never be described as full-source hashes.
sourceInterpretation.normativeBoundary: Web standards do not establish that all raw rAF timestamps are <= callback-entry performance.now(). The new native method is a versioned pinned-browser instrumentation contract, not a claim that the original cross-API predicate is fixed or universally specified.
sourceInterpretation.boundedConclusion: The source/empirical combination is sufficient to justify isolated V3 engineering with fail-closed per-run native evidence. It does not by itself grant formal qualification, cross-browser support or retrospective validation.

proposedV3Contract.version: Explicit distinct V3 method/schema, opt-in; unknown/malformed versions are UNVERIFIED/NOT RUN.
causalMembership: Capture the actual returned native requestAnimationFrame handle in its callback closure; retain original raw RAF and observedNow Float64 bits, collection id and ordinal without rewriting.

Emit one fixed-schema no-options performance.mark for the representative callback of each original raw-RAF group. Its unique name carries exact collection/ordinal/handle/raw-bits/observed-bits; additional callbacks remain separately accounted.
Require exact unique matching mark, expected navigation/frame/renderer pid/tid and supported mark schema. A missing/duplicate/foreign mark or unknown loss/cap/close state invalidates eligibility.

Require exactly one supported complete native FireAnimationFrame for that handle and document/thread. Physical mark callTime must be finite and inside the Fire span and original native anchor window; Fire itself must lie inside the original window. Do not add epsilon or clip evidence into eligibility.

Actual native-readiness must also pass: supported devtools.timeline Fire records, unique CrRendererMain metadata, validated toplevel renderer tasks and trace completeness. The causal validator alone never grants formal eligibility.

Request records are optional corroboration because registration may precede tracing. A matching annotation must have supported shape/category/phase/finite ordering if labeled validated; otherwise label it only matching captured metadata.

Keep original raw timestamp validity/strict ordering, leading-sample/window/count/coverage rules except that V3 defines membership through the positive native identity proof rather than using rawRAF<=observedNow as a prerequisite. Preserve that old relation as an exact raw diagnostic and preserve old V2 results.
proposedV3Contract.oneClockClaim: Only callTime containment in native Fire and original native anchor bounds uses native trace-clock evidence. Raw RAF timestamps remain in the unchanged numerical bin mapping. Do not describe the entire metric as free of clock mapping.

exactNumericInvariants.mapping: beginUs + ((time - origin) / sampleMilliseconds) * (endUs - beginUs), in the exact original binary64 operation order
exactNumericInvariants.anchors: Original matching begin/end mark event.ts; never shift them to observation callTime, callback-entry time, Fire start/end, or rebinned values.
exactNumericInvariants.nativeTaskMetric: Same native-microsecond renderer task clipping, sorting and union, then intersection with the unchanged bins; divide durations by 1000 only. No duration rescaling, overhead subtraction, epsilon, rounding or clamping.
exactNumericInvariants.loadAndThresholds: All frozen original workloads, physics/worker tick and cadence, trace delivery, sampling/count/loss gates, fixed numeric thresholds and acceptance oracles stay unchanged. Proof instrumentation cost stays in the metric.
exactNumericInvariants.candidateSchemaGate: Validate every relevant same-renderer named native task candidate before numeric computation, including finite(ts+dur), nonnegative duration, supported phase/category and event shape. Mixed valid plus malformed/overflow/wrong-category data must not be rescued by one valid task or silently omitted. Unsupported evidence yields UNVERIFIED/NOT RUN; the old numeric implementation and tests remain unchanged.

collectionResources.required: Choose explicit bounded formal callback/frame/proof/mark/name-byte/pending-handle caps, plus existing compressed/decompressed/event/window/wall/storage budgets. A cap hit, drop, ambiguous handle reuse, unknown counter, post-close sample or unsupported state invalidates eligibility. Do not simply change 128 to 90000.
collectionResources.counters: Maintained collector must implement actual close/drop/cap accounting; finite pilot constants are not adequate telemetry for a long product run.
collectionResources.markLifetime: Mark clearing is NOT RUN in R3. Smallest semantic choice is to retain bounded marks throughout the collection and budget their memory; clearing during the window requires its own bounded exact-browser persistence pilot. Never imply clearing is proven.
collectionResources.overhead: Native observation work is nonzero in principle and included in whole-window renderer tasks. The ordered six/six micro-observation pair is descriptive only; no causal overhead estimate, zero-overhead conclusion or aggregate browser CPU claim is justified.

proposedV3Contract.categoryPolicy: Retain the original fixed category string. Bounded valid GetCategories metadata, including an empty list, is advisory only. Preserve R2's actual pretrace failure. R3 can proceed only when actual required native records independently satisfy the strict per-run readiness contract.

existingEvidenceLimits.pilotOnly: R3 has six representative raw frames and 23 callbacks under a short arithmetic-only page. It does not reproduce the historical 2e-8 ms relation failure, exercise the product load, or qualify a 600-second run.
existingEvidenceLimits.numeric: Retained synthetic fixtures show exact V2/V3 Float64 bin/occupancy agreement. This is not proof for every binary64 input. The independent rational endpoint-arrangement oracle expresses mathematical intent under its bounded literal domain and imports no analyzer.
existingEvidenceLimits.otherAcceptance: All other V1 performance/UI/physics/worker/recording/audio/hearing/external gates retain their actual statuses.

minimalMaintainedPlan: Root reviews this source-method assessment and the separately owned independent R3 raw review. No source edit or run is authorized by this cache report itself.

Freeze a distinct V3 schema and method document with exact numeric invariants and a supported pinned-native-schema contract. Preserve original three files, their legacy test invocation and all old artifacts.

Implement new opt-in sibling collector/analyzer/runner/report plumbing against the real workload, rather than promoting cache modules or making V2 silently use V3. Keep immutable source/bundle/browser/resource receipts.

Compose bounded JSON/schema validation, live close/drop/cap counters, native candidate-task validation, causal identity and actual-native-readiness gates before unchanged numeric evaluation. Invalid proof produces NOT RUN, never zero occupancy.

Add the focused negatives and independent numeric fixtures below in new files. Run the original V2 tests unchanged plus focused V3 tests and the independently implemented reference; preserve actual process results and source hashes.
Resolve mark-lifetime/resource policy. If using clearMarks during collection, a separately reviewed tiny exact-browser persistence pilot is required; otherwise quantify bounded retained mark storage.

After independent review, run a separately budgeted short real-workload qualifier to validate wiring, all old gates, caps, cleanup, evidence/report isolation and comparable load. It cannot stand in for formal duration.

Only after those conditions and Root review should a new formal 600-second resource plan be considered. No unchanged 600-second V2 rerun, old evidence upgrade or overall-V1 completion follows from this assessment.
requiredNewNegativeFixtures: Mixed one valid renderer task plus malformed/null/overflow ts+dur/negative duration/nonfinite candidate; wrong or malformed category and unsupported native phase/shape. No valid task may hide another invalid relevant candidate.

Unknown/missing method version, wrong top-level/array types, null events, oversized metadata/name/proof structures; controlled UNVERIFIED receipt rather than unhandled exception or implicit method fallback.

Fire valid except wrong category or document/thread; finite callTime with wrong units/strictly outside span/exact edges; missing/duplicate native id; exact bit/name mismatch; altered custom startTime where event.ts is misleading.
Pretrace registration with no retained Request event is eligible only with complete primary Fire/mark proof; malformed present Request must not earn a validated corroboration label.

Live close lifecycle, samples after close, actual cap boundary versus cap+1, repeated same-RAF callbacks, ambiguous reused handles/wrap, proof/frame count mismatch, navigation swap, missing mark/thread metadata and trace loss.

Retained leading raw timestamp semantics, exact bin/anchor edge points, touching/overlapping/cross-bin native tasks, fractional two-anchor mapping, and exact 50000 us edge-coverage pass/fail boundaries.
If clearing selected: separate native trace persistence before/after clear and missing-evidence negative; otherwise bounded retained-mark count and name-byte accounting.

independentReferencePlan.keepOriginalTests: Original tests/integration/performance-profile.test.mjs remains byte-for-byte unchanged and is executed unchanged in the future validation bundle.
independentReferencePlan.numeric: Maintain a reference that imports neither production V2 nor V3 analyzer. Use rational endpoint arrangement for union/intersection mathematical intent, plus explicit binary64 operation-order fixtures to compare old and new bins/occupancies bit-for-bit on eligible bounded inputs. Do not widen thresholds or normalize outputs.
independentReferencePlan.eligibility: Independent reviewer inspects supported native schema, captured raw bits/handles/document identity and negative fixtures from immutable receipts; do not let implementation output alone declare its membership proof valid.
independentReferencePlan.limits: Pure/reference success proves only its stated fixtures. Short live evidence proves plumbing for its own pinned environment; formal duration/load and other acceptance tests remain separate.
